title: Baa Juice Strawberry Ice Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Strawberry Ice Shortfill takes a classic fruit flavour and gives it a chilled edge. Juicy, sweet Strawberry delivers a bright burst of berry flavour, while an icy finish brings cool clarity to every draw. The balance of sweet and brisk notes makes this a refreshing fruit-and-menthol vape. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two nic shots if required. Blended at 50/50 ratio, this Shortfill is designed for MTL pod kits to produce a balanced vaping style with vibrant flavour. Baa Juice Shortfills are mixed with double-concentrated flavouring, offering a strong, impactful taste that lasts throughout the day.
